Let’s break it down quickly:  

- US/Hawaii UTC offset = -10  
- US/Eastern UTC offset = -5 (standard time in November)  
- Time difference = (-5) - (-10) = +5 hours  
- 21:00 (Hawaii) + 5 hours = 02:00 next day  
- November 16 → November 17 after crossing midnight.  

FINAL_ANSWER: November 17, 02:00
